name: Classic Who
description: An exiled Time Lord called the Doctor travels time and space in the TARDIS, a ship disguised as a police box, with the companions he gathers along the way. Seven Doctors across 26 seasons of multi-part serials, from An Unearthly Child in 1963 to Survival in 1989.

name: Wilderness Years
description: The years between the end of the original run in 1989 and the revival in 2005, when Doctor Who was off the air. The Doctor lived on in a 1996 television film, charity specials and animated stories made for the BBC website.

name: New Who
description: The Doctor returns as the last of the Time Lords, still travelling time and space in the TARDIS with companions from Earth after a war that ended his people. Seven Doctors, the Ninth to the Fifteenth, across sixteen seasons from Rose in 2005 to the present day.

name: Torchwood
description: Captain Jack Harkness leads a secret Cardiff institute that catches whatever falls through the Rift, in the darker spin-off made for adults. Four series, from the standalone cases of the early years to the worldwide crises of Children of Earth and Miracle Day.

name: The Sarah Jane Adventures
description: Sarah Jane Smith, the Doctor's longest-serving companion, investigates alien activity from her attic on Bannerman Road with her son Luke and his friends. Five series of family adventures that run in step with the Tenth and Eleventh Doctors' eras.

name: Class
description: Coal Hill Academy sixth-formers guard a tear in space and time left behind by the Doctor's many visits, with an alien prince and his exiled guardian hiding among the students. A single eight-episode series from 2016.

name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
description: An ancient species rises from the ocean floor to claim the planet, and UNIT stands between humanity and the deep. A five-part story from December 2025, the newest branch of the Whoniverse.

name: Complete Chronology
description: Every Doctor Who story in one running order, from An Unearthly Child in 1963 to the newest arrival, with the spin-offs alongside the show they grew out of. One list instead of seven.
